events.text:
T-237 is back in review. The join-link fix (a67da2c) was already pushed and live in production, so I didn't push or deploy anything.

1. **Push:** not needed. a67da2c is already part of origin/main (head 93ad5697).
2. **Probe:** passes 16 of 16 on a fresh local copy of origin/main against vendor-sim. I stopped the local servers and removed the copy afterwards.
3. **Deploy:** not needed. The live Worker 25396394 was deployed by another task on 11 Oct at 18:38 UTC, after the fix reached origin/main. Redeploying would only have shipped other tasks' changes.
4. **Production checks:**
   - The page shows the 15 Oct webinar.
   - Repeat sign-ups as [email]: tries 1 to 20 got the saved join link back, and tries 21 and 22 were refused ("Too many tries", 429).
   - The test sign-up still shows 1 try and was not updated, so none of the repeats reached Zoom.
   - A placeholder email still gets the blank reply, and a request from another site is refused (403).
5. **Revert ledger:** new entry committed as 73f5116e. Nothing to undo: the 22 tries drop out of the hourly count on their own.
6. **Task state:** set to review with evidence, and note F-477dd370 acknowledged. Tantra reminder import still waits on T-234, so sign-ups stay pending until then.
